_comment: Centralized MITRE ATT&CK mapping configuration. The mapping engine (src/core/mitre.py) resolves a finding to techniques by (1) an exact canonical signature match, then (2) keyword patterns matched against the finding title+signature+module+description. A pattern only contributes a technique when its 'any' keywords are present (and none of its 'not' keywords). New mappings are added here WITHOUT changing any audit module. Techniques are only assigned where the finding technically supports the relationship.

NET_RDP_EXPOSED.rationale: TCP/3389 reachable exposes Remote Desktop for interactive lateral movement.

NET_SMB_EXPOSED.rationale: TCP/445 reachable exposes SMB, usable for admin-share lateral movement.

NET_WINRM_EXPOSED.rationale: WinRM (5985/5986) reachable enables remote PowerShell execution.

NET_SSH_EXPOSED.rationale: TCP/22 reachable exposes SSH remote access.

NET_LDAP_EXPOSED.rationale: LDAP reachable can be queried for domain account enumeration.

NET_OPEN_PORTS.rationale: Reachable listening services form the network attack surface.
